notes: Sibling of `erp-contactpersonen-debiteur.json` — read that file's first three notes for the full reasoning behind the design (one `PUT` to the existing debiteur/crediteur's own connector, matched by `@CrId`, with a new `KnContact`→`KnPerson` inserted underneath rather than a two-call chain through standalone `KnPerson`/`KnContact` connectors). This file covers `Contact bij = C` rows.

One real schema difference from the Debiteur side, confirmed live rather than assumed symmetric: `KnPurchaseRelationOrg`'s nested `KnContact` has **no `ViKc`** field at all (the Debiteur side's nested `KnContact` does, fixed there to `'PRS'`). So there is nothing to set here, fixed or otherwise — this isn't an oversight, it's the connector's own schema. Every other field on this nested `KnContact` (`PadAdr`, `ExAd`, `ViFu`, `FuDs`, `Corr`, `ViMd`, `TeNr`, `FaNr`, `MbNr`, `EmAd`, `HoPa`, `Re`, `Bl`, `AtLn`, `LeHe`, `SocN`, `Face`, `Link`, `Twtr`) matches the Debiteur side exactly.

`CrId` here is the match key for an *existing* crediteur (`@CrId`, confirmed `primaryKey: true` live), the same role `DbId` plays on the Debiteur side and the opposite of its role in `erp-crediteuren-organisatie.json` (there it's a value being set on a brand-new crediteur).

`AddToPortal`/`PadAdr`/`ResZip` fixed, `MatchPer` left unmapped, `SeNm` capped at 10 characters, `HmNr` a strict `int`, `BeginDate` unmapped as ignored-on-first-address — all identical reasoning to the Debiteur sibling.

Ordering constraint: this `PUT` only succeeds against a crediteur that already exists, so a client's contactpersonen conversion can only run after their crediteuren conversion has landed. See docs/todo.md.

`erp-contactpersonen` has no deeltaakcode in AFAS, so this module cannot appear for a project today — groundwork, same as its sibling. No upload engine exists yet to run per-object `@Action` from a stored mapping at all.
Not grouped: one contactpersoon row produces one inserted KnContact + KnPerson pair, nested under the one existing crediteur the row names.

verifiedAgainst.description: Live GET metainfo/update/KnPurchaseRelationOrg via /api/afas/updateconnectors/modules/KnPurchaseRelationOrg — root/name 'KnPurchaseRelationOrg', `CrId` confirmed primaryKey. Nested tree: KnOrganisation → {KnBankAccount, KnBasicAddressAdr, KnBasicAddressPad, KnContact → {KnBasicAddressAdr, KnBasicAddressPad, KnPerson → {KnBankAccount, KnBasicAddressAdr, KnBasicAddressPad}}}. KnContact here has no BcCoOga/BcCoPer, same as the Debiteur side, and no ViKc, unlike it.
